newsitem.title: USA: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.

text.p: Livestock analysts estimate Friday's hog slaughter from 360,000 to 368,000 head versus 360,000 a week ago and 353,000 a year ago.
Saturday's hog slaughter estimates ranged from 45,000 to 50,000 head versus 48,000 a week ago and 91,000 a year ago.
Cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 127,000 to 130,000 head versus 129,000 a week ago and 128,000 a year ago.
Saturday's cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 28,000 to 45,000 head versus 26,000 a week ago and 32,000 a year ago.
